content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This infrastructure enables creators to deploy sovereign digital commerce stacks, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership – a stark contrast to traditional platforms that charge high fees and exert control over creators' businesses. By leveraging NOWPayments and Solana, creators can maintain full control over their operations, scale efficiently, and focus on producing high-quality digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture allows creators to deploy their stacks quickly, test them thoroughly, and scale without limitations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. By providing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can reach their global audience, sell their products without platform fees, and maintain full control over their businesses. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
By leveraging NOWPayments and Solana, creators can bypass platform fees and maintain full control over their digital businesses.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can follow these steps: shop for the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, download the kit, and start building their stack using the included blueprints and templates. Once built, deploy the stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment verification. By following these steps, creators can bypass traditional payment processors and maintain full control over their digital businesses.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.

Configure GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment verification and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. By following these steps, you can bypass traditional payment processors and maintain full control over your digital business.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing digital product store?

To integrate NOWPayments, simply copy and paste the provided payment button code into your store's HTML, configuring the necessary settings to match your NOWPayments account. This ensures seamless payment processing and automatic on-chain verification.
Can I use a different cryptocurrency besides Solana with NOWPayments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and many others. You can choose the cryptocurrency that best suits your business needs and preferences.
How do I configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

Configure backend logic by setting up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle tasks such as payment processing, order storage, and file delivery. This modular architecture ensures efficient scaling and customization.
What is the fee structure for using NOWPayments with Solana?

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, with no KYC requirements or buyer account needed. This fee structure provides a significant cost savings compared to traditional payment processors like Gumroad.
Can I customize the design of my digital product store using the included blueprints and templates?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 7 templates, allowing you to customize the design of your digital product store to match your brand and preferences.
